name: @vipentti/npm-release-flow
description: Reusable npm release toolkit: CLI plus reusable GitHub Actions release workflow

scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs knip.json ".github/workflows/*.yml" README.md RELEASE.md CHANGELOG.md SECURITY.md "bin/**/*.mjs" "src/**/*.mjs" "test/**/*.mjs"
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs knip.json ".github/workflows/*.yml" README.md RELEASE.md CHANGELOG.md SECURITY.md "bin/**/*.mjs" "src/**/*.mjs" "test/**/*.mjs"
scripts.release:verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run knip && npm test
